VPS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Cockpit/console login password for VPS_ADMIN_USER (or root if unset)

VPS_ADMIN_SSH_KEY.description: Public key to authorize for VPS_ADMIN_USER and root

VPS_PRIVATE_INTERFACE.description: Interface carrying private-only services (set by vps-tailscale; give wg0, a LAN NIC... to use another network)

VPS_ADMIN_USER.description: Optional non-root sudo user to create

VPS_SECRETS_FILE.description: Owner-only env file holding the credentials the steps generate

COCKPIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Owner-only env file holding COCKPIT_ADMIN_USER and COCKPIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD (the saved Cockpit/console login)
